headline: Petchsrivichai Enterprise Backs Thai Plan to Expand B20 Biodiesel Use
summary: SET-listed Petchsrivichai Enterprise (PCE) stated it is prepared to support government plans to expand B20 biodiesel usage, citing sufficient processing capacity despite weather pressures on palm oil yields.
why: Biodiesel mandates alter domestic demand for agricultural feedstocks such as crude palm oil in major producing nations.
